title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK TIRANA PARK AVENUE!!! 260,000 €

title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT TIRANA PARK AVENUE!!! €260,000
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 and parking post on New Boulevard for sale! The apartment has a total area of ​​123.6 m², of which 103.6 m² are net living area and 36.6 m² functional veranda - perfect for lounge furniture, greenery, dining area or relaxation. This apartment is suitable both for family residence and as a long-term investment, in one of the areas with the most dynamic development and stable market valuation. A parking spot is included in the price. For more information contact us!
